description: This file defines a FastAPI web application with a single endpoint `/items/`. The endpoint accepts a query parameter `hidden_query` which is an optional union of string and None, annotated with Query(include_in_schema=False), indicating it is hidden from schema generation. It returns a JSON response showing the value of `hidden_query` or a default message.

methods.name: read_items( hidden_query: Annotated[Union[str, None], Query(include_in_schema=False)] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronous function handling GET requests to `/items/` that retrieves a hidden query parameter `hidden_query` and returns it in the response.
